welcome.title: Welcome to TPA
welcome.subtitle: Trains, Planes and Automobiles (and Boats)
lines: A live map of UK transport: planes, trains, buses and road traffic.
Free for everyone, always. No adverts and no subscriptions.
This is a test version. Live layers show real data; anything marked MOCK is a pretend example.

tip.label: Buy me a coffee
tip.note: Completely optional. TPA stays free either way.

credits.text: Bus data sourced via the Department for Transport's Bus Open Data Service (BODS). Roads: contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026 (OS Open Roads, Open Government Licence v3.0). Between reports, positions along the road are estimated for up to 90 seconds.

Contains information of Network Rail Infrastructure Limited licensed under the following licence: Network Rail Infrastructure Limited Data Feeds Licence. Railway lines: Network Rail track model (OGL). Stations: DfT NaPTAN (OGL). Junctions: YA TIPLOC list (CC BY-SA 4.0 / OGL). Between reports, train positions along the track are estimated.
Aircraft positions from ADSB.lol (Open Database License). Between reports, positions are estimated from speed and direction.
